authority: run-fact = capture-full log embedded scripts (README: rip script before '==='); paper > PR text > README only where log absent

common_benchmark.model: GPT-2-class: 12 layers, model_dim=768, 6 heads x 128 head_dim (attn), MLP hdim=4*768, RMSNorm (gain), RoPE, relu().square() activation, logit soft-cap 15, vocab 50304
common_benchmark.precision: params fp32 + compiled fwd (bf16 embed/NS internals)
common_benchmark.dist: torchrun NCCL, world_size 1/2/4/8 (assert 8%ws==0), grad all-reduce SUM; H100x8 in public runs
common_benchmark.ns: steps=12, coeff=(2.0,-1.5,0.5), bf16, norm+1e-7, same for ALL three recipes

muonh_original_5.matrix_optimizer: MuonH per shape-class (qkv / mlp.fc / attn.proj / mlp.proj as 4 separate optimizer instances, same hypers, for compile-cache)
muonh_original_5.hyperball: per-matrix: p_norm=||W||; step=lr*update*p_norm/clamp(||update||,1e-10); renorm to p_norm; eps=1e-10
muonh_original_5.init: PyTorch default Kaiming-uniform (nn.Linear) then multipliers: attn.proj x1.25, mlp.proj x3.0, mlp.fc x1.5; head proj.weight=0, all proj biases=0, embed=default
muonh_original_5.aux_optimizer: AdamW fused: embed lr=0.3, head lr=1/320, 1D lr=0.01, betas=(0.8,0.95), eps=1e-10, wd=0
muonh_original_5.schedule: linear-to-zero cooldown, NO warmup: matrix cooldown_frac=1.0, aux cooldown_frac=0.4

tuned_muon_36.source: logs/TunedMuon_3250.txt (== master snapshot; hardware: H100x8, torch 2.10.0+cu128); PR323
tuned_muon_36.matrix_optimizer: single Muon over all blocks 2D weights
tuned_muon_36.init: proj weights zero; embed normal_(); other weights normal_(std=0.33^0.5/fan_in^0.5); biases zero; gains ~N(1,0)
tuned_muon_36.aux_optimizer: AdamW fused: embed lr=0.7, head lr=0.004, 1D lr=0.015, betas=(0.8,0.95), eps=1e-10, wd=0.001

tuned_aux_muonh_37.matrix_optimizer: single MuonH over all blocks 2D weights (not per-shape split)
tuned_aux_muonh_37.init: normal_(std=0.33^0.5/fan_in^0.5) base then SAME multipliers x1.25/x3.0/x1.5; embed normal_; biases zero; gains N(1,0)  [NOTE: base init differs from #5 — #5 keeps nn.Linear Kaiming-uniform default, #37 re-draws normal]
tuned_aux_muonh_37.aux_optimizer: AdamW fused: embed lr=0.910, head lr=0.0064, 1D lr=0.0195, betas=(0.8,0.95), eps=1e-10, wd=0.001 (grafted from #36, retuned ~x1.3)
tuned_aux_muonh_37.schedule: matrix cooldown_frac=1.0, aux cooldown_frac=0.85, NO warmup
